newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish March M2 increases 2.1 pct yr/yr - cen bank.
newsitem.headline: Finnish March M2 increases 2.1 pct yr/yr - cen bank.

text.p: Finland's M2 money aggregate rose 2.1 percent year-on-year in March after a 0.7 percent fall in February, the Bank of Finland said on Wednesday.
NOTE: M1 comprises currency in circulation, and cheques, giro and transaction accounts.
M2 comprises M1 and fixed-term and other bank deposits held by the public.
M3 comprises M2 plus outstanding bank certificates of deposits held by the public.

The Bank of Finland has not published targets for the money aggregates, but it has said they are among the economic indicators it monitors to quide monetary policy. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
